custom, usage
nature, natural state or condition of anything
prevalence, currency
received or established authority, especially of codes of law
accordance, conformity to usage
consequence, result

अनुसारतः, अनुसारेण — (in comp.) In accordance with, conformably to.

m: अनु-सार—तस् ind. conformably to.
अनु-सारेण (एण), or -तस्, ind. conformably to.

अनु-सैन्य n. the rear of an army, L.
a: अनुसैन्यं — [सैन्यमनुगतं] The rear of an army, rear-guard.

m: अनु-सीरम् ind. along the plough, (g. परिमुखादि, q.v.)
अनु-सीतम् ind. along the furrow, TS.
(g. परिमुखादि, q.v.)

a: अनुस्फुर — a. Ved. Whizzing (as an arrow).

m: अनु-सू m. N. of wk. Pāṇ., Comm.
अनु-सूचक mf(इका)n. (√ सूच्), indicative of, pointing out.
a: अनुसूचक — a. Indicative of, pointing out to.

m: अनु-सूचन n. pointing out, indication.
a: अनुसूचनं — Indication, pointing out.

v: anusUyA

m: अनु-सं-√ धा to explore, ascertain, inspect, plan, arrange; to calm, compose, set in order; to aim at.
a: अनुसंधा — {c3c} U. 1 To search into or after, look after, inquire into, investigate, explore, examine, ascertain; प्रसवयोग्यं स्थानमनुसंधीयतां H. 3; Ms. 12. 106. --2 To calm, compose, quiet; आत्मानमनुसंधेहि शोकचर्चां च परिहर H. 4. --3 To think of, aim at, refer or allude to, consider, deliberate; यथाकर्तव्यमनुसंधयितां H. 3; नैतदनुसंधाय मयोक्तं Mv. 6 after deliberation, or because I aimed at it; अलमनेनातीतोपालंभेन प्रस्तुतमनुसंधीयतां H. 3 let us consider what is before us, (turn to the matter in hand); अत्र… इति पुरावृत्तकथानुऽ संधेया Malli. on Ku. 1. 21 should be sought or referred to. --4 To plan, arrange; prepare, set in order; सारसत्वं दुर्गमनुसंधेहि, दुर्गशोधनमनुसंधातव्यं H. 3. --5 To follow, go after, attend, accompany; चरेण अनुसंधीयमानः Mu. 6; कस्ते निर्बंधः पदे पदे मामनुसंधातुं Mk. 1; एतौ तौ मामनुसंधत्तः Mk. 2 are after me. --6 To take up, follow, continue; तच्छेषमात्मवचसाप्यऽनुसंदधानः K. 240 following, making up the unfinished portion &c.

m: अनु-संधानीय mfn. to be attended to, Kāvyād.
अनु-संधान n. investigation, inquiry, searching into, close inspection, setting in order, arranging, planning
aiming at
plan, scheme, congruous or suitable connection
(in the Vaiśeṣika phil.) the fourth step in a syllogism (i.e. the application).
a: अनुसंधानं — 1 Inquiry, investigation; close inspection or scrutiny, examination; Mv. 7. --2 Aiming at. H. --3 Planning, arranging, getting ready &c.; दुर्गानुसंधाने को नियुज्यतां H. 3 equipping with the necessary materials. --4 A plan, scheme. --5 Suitable connection. --6 (In the Vaiś. phil.) The 4th step in a syllogism, the उपनय or application.

m: अनु-संधानिन् mfn. investigating, searching, skilful at concerting or carrying out schemes.
a: अनुसंधानिन्, --संधायिन् — a. Investigating, looking after; skilful in concerting plans.

m: अनु-संधातव्य mfn. to be explored, to be investigated, to be looked after, &c.
अनु-संधायिन् mfn. id.
अनु-संधेय mfn. to be investigated, worthy of inquiry or scrutiny, &c.
अनु-संधि m. (in dram.) juncture of a Patākā or episode, Bhar.
अनु-सं-√ ख्या Caus. P. -ख्या-पयति, to cause to observe, show, ŚBr.

a: अनुसंबद्ध — a. Connected with.

m: अनु-सं-√ चर् to walk along side, to follow, join; to visit; to pursue, seek after; to penetrate, traverse, cross; to become assimilated: Caus. P. -चारयति, to join, become identified or assimilated with.
a: अनुसंचर् — {c1c} P. 1 To walk alongside, follow, join. --2 To pursue, seek after. --3 To visit, go towards or to. --4 To penetrate, cross, traverse. --5 To become assimilated.

m: अनु-सं-चर mfn. following or accompanying (with acc.), TBr.

a: अनुसंचरणं — Following, pursuing. --adv. At every occasion of coming.

m: अनु-सं-√ चिन्त् to meditate.
अनु-सं-√ दह् to burn up along the whole length, AV.
अनु-सं-√ दृश् (ind.p. -दृश्य) to consider successively, MBh. xii, 12024.
अनु-सं-√ दिश् to assign, to make over.
अनु-सं-√ ग्रह् to oblige, favour; to salute by laying hold of the feet.
अनु-सं-√ हृ to drag (the foot), Kauś.; to compress, reduce a subject, Lāṭy.

v: anusaMhita
tri॰ anu + sam + DA--karmmaRi kta । kftAnusanDAne yasya jYAnArTamanvezaRAdikam kriyate tasmin । saMhitAyAM viBa॰ avyayI॰ । saMhitAyAmityarTe । ‘aTEke prAhuranusaMhitamiti fgvedaprAtiRAKyam ।
a: अनुसंहित — p. p. Inquired into, investigated; connected with, in accordance or union with, conformable to; अहिंसा सर्वधर्मानुसंहिता Mb.; अर्थधर्मानुसंहितं वाक्यं Rām. --तं adv. In the Saṃhitā text; according to this text.

m: अनु-संहितम् ind. according to the Saṃhitā text, RPrāt.
अनु-संज्ञप्ति f. explanation, Divyāv.

अनु-सं-√ 2. कल् to drive or convey along or after, ĀśvGṛ.
अनु-सं-√ क्रम् to walk or go up to, to reach, AV.

अनु-सं-स्थित mfn. following
dead or deceased after (another), Ragh.

(Caus., also) to make progress through, ib.
अनु-सं-√ सृप् to creep or crawl after, ŚBr.; TBr.
अनु-सं-सृष्ट mfn. joined to (instr.), BhP.
अनु-सं-√ स्मृ to remember, to long for (the dead or absent).
अनु-सं-√ स्पृश् Caus. to cause to touch after, ŚBr.
अनु-सं-√ स्यन्द् Intens. (p. nom. m. अनु सं-सनिष्यदत्) to run after, VS. ix, 14 (cf. Pāṇ. vii, 4, 65.)

a: अनुसंततिः — f. Continued succession, continuity.

अनु-सं-√ वह् to draw or run by the side of AV.; to convey along, TBr.
अनु-सं-√ वर्ण् to approve of Divyāv.

following, seeking, Daśar.

constantly, BhP.

a: अनुसृष्ट — a. Created in succession.

m: अनु-√ स्मृ to remember, recollect: Caus. P. -स्मारयति, or -स्मरयति, to remind (with acc.), Kir. v, 14.
a: अनुस्मृ — {c1c} P. To remember, think of, call to mind, recollect (with acc. or gen.); वरप्रार्थनामनुस्मृत्य Ś. 1; यदैव अनुस्मृतं देवेन Ś. 7; तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च Bg. 8. 7; व्यपगतमदरागस्यानुसस्मार लक्ष्मीं Ki. 4. 38. --Caus. To remind (painfully), cause to remember with regret; Ki. 5. 14.

m: अनु-स्मृत mfn. remembered.

a: अनुस्मृतिः — f. 1 Cherished recollection; thinking of; अनुस्मृतेर्बादरिः Ś. B. --2 Thinking of one thing to the exclusion of others.
अनुस्नेहं — ind. After adding oil.

m: अनु-स्नेहम् ind. after (adding) oil, Suśr.
अनु-सोमम् ind. according to the (practice with the) Soma, as with the Soma, KātyŚr.
अनु-स्पन्द्यम् ind. along the cord, BaudhP.
अनु-स्पष्ट mfn. noticed, RV. x, 160, 4.
अनु-स्पष्ट See अनु-√ पश्.
a: अनुस्पष्ट — a. Plain, obvious.

m: अनु-√ स्पृश् to touch, extend to, RV. iv, 4, 2.
अन्-उस्र-यामन् m. not going out during daylight, RV. iv, 32, 24.
अनु-स्रोतस mfn. in the direction of the current of a river, ĀpGṛ.
अनु-स्तनित n. continual thundering, Āpast.
अनु-स्तरणी f. the cow sacrificed at the funeral ceremony, TS. &c.

m: अनु-स्तरण m. (√ स्तृ), an animal which is fit to be chosen as a secondary victim
a: अनुस्तरणं — Strewing or spreading round. --णी [करणे ल्युट्] 1 A cover, (आच्छादनं such as leather); अनुस्तरण्या वपामुत्खिद्य शिरोमुखं प्रच्छादयेत् Āśval. --2 A cow; (सेयं गौः स्तृतं दीक्षितमनुस्तृतत्वाद्धिंसितत्वाच्चानुस्तरणीत्युच्यते Sāy.); especially the cow sacrificed at the funeral ceremony, which enables the departed spirit to safely cross the river of Hell called वैतरिणी (अनुतीर्यते वैतरिणी नदी अनया तॄ-करणे ल्युट् पृषो-सुट् Tv.).

m: अनु-स्तोत्र n. ‘praising after’, N. of a treatise relating to the Sāma-veda.
a: अनुस्तोत्रं — Praising after; N. of a work relating to the Sāmaveda.

m: अनु-स्वान m. sounding conformably, Sāh.
a: अनुस्वानः — 1 Sounding conformably to. --2 An after sound; echo; see अनुरणन and K. P. 4 (36).
